stories.new_fact: AP reported ICE’s release of fiscal-year arrest and deportation totals.
stories.new_takeaway: A released aggregate changes oversight and administrative workloads, not every local obligation overnight.
stories.why_now: The agency’s fiscal-year report was newly reported November 12.
stories.previous_coverage: No prior seven-episode segment used this release.
stories.uncertainty: Aggregate figures do not establish local impacts or legal outcomes.
stories.watch: Oversight requests, funding, litigation, and methodology disclosures.

stories.new_fact: Axios reported a phased timetable toward a thirteen-member district Council by 2030.
stories.new_takeaway: Implementation details, especially maps and hearings, determine the usable effect of a ballot change.
stories.why_now: The local implementation report is new.
stories.previous_coverage: Prior episodes covered election results, not this stated transition path.
stories.uncertainty: Map and election details remain to be adopted.
stories.watch: Formal timetable, map criteria, and public-hearing schedule.

stories.new_fact: Freddie Mac reported a 7.11 percent average thirty-year fixed rate while AP reported October sales at a sixteen-year low and 1.59 million unsold homes.
stories.new_takeaway: Teams should distinguish rate-sensitive lead volume from durable conversion and locked production.
stories.why_now: Both the weekly rate release and the sales report were published November 12.
stories.previous_coverage: This is a fresh sales-and-pipeline interpretation, not the November 12 ULDD specification story.
stories.uncertainty: Weekly averages do not determine individual pricing or future sales.
stories.watch: Next survey, Treasury yields, inventory, and sales conversion.

stories.new_fact: Bankwest describes context-and-summary transfer to a human colleague in customer chat.
stories.new_takeaway: A handoff tool should be evaluated on routing and resolution accuracy, not summary fluency.
stories.why_now: It is clearly labeled older implementation background, used to test the fresh frontier implementation-capacity claim rather than as breaking news.
stories.previous_coverage: The previous seven scripts did not use Bankwest or this contact-center task.
stories.uncertainty: No handling-time, resolution, error, complaint, or independent result is disclosed.
stories.watch: Production volume, transfer accuracy, repeat contacts, and escalation outcomes.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Bankwest / consumer servicing: added announced context-preserving chat handoff row, with no disclosed metric.

stories.new_fact: Anthropic announced a $100 million Frontier Academy targeting 10,000 deployed engineers by end-2027.
stories.new_takeaway: Implementation capacity is a constraint, but training announcements are not workflow-outcome evidence.
stories.previous_coverage: The previous seven scripts did not cover this program.
stories.uncertainty: The company gives no completion, task-quality, customer-return, or independent comparison data.
stories.watch: Named deployments with baselines, outcome metrics, and limitations.
stories.frontier_bar: price or access shift / implementation capacity; company claim, not a model benchmark.

stories.new_fact: AP reported Treasury-yield, oil, and technology-share volatility.
stories.new_takeaway: Yield volatility connects market expectations to lending price sensitivity.
stories.uncertainty: One session does not establish a trend.
stories.watch: Yields, oil, and incoming inflation evidence.
